sources.title: Visa Form
sources.officialityEvidence: The live moi.gov.af Ministry of Interior service page has current 2026 ministry content and links to a visa form, but supplies no eligibility, issuance, nationality or entry rules.
sources.supportingExcerpt: For the visa form click here.

sources.title: Notice to Turkish citizens travelling to Afghanistan
sources.publisher: Republic of Türkiye Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The live mfa.gov.tr page is a current Republic of Türkiye Foreign Ministry notice addressed to Turkish citizens and directs them to Afghanistan’s Ankara Embassy or Istanbul Consulate for the appropriate visa.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Türk citizens travelling to Afghanistan must obtain an appropriate visa from Afghanistan’s Ankara Embassy or Istanbul Consulate.

sources.title: Visa — Embassy of Afghanistan in Ankara
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ankara mission page identifies itself as the Embassy of Afghanistan, has a 2025 site copyright, and is the named visa-issuing mission in Türkiye MFA’s live Afghanistan notice.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Normal processing: 5 business days; express processing: 1 day.

policies.title: Turkish ordinary passports: Afghanistan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Türkiye’s Foreign Ministry currently directs Turkish citizens travelling to Afghanistan to obtain the purpose-appropriate visa, including tourist visas, from Afghanistan’s Ankara Embassy or Istanbul Consulate before travel.
conditions: This is a nationality-specific Turkish-citizen short-visitor rule: obtain the appropriate visa, including a tourist visa, from Afghanistan’s Embassy in Ankara or Consulate General in Istanbul before travel.
The current Ankara mission page lists normal processing as five business days and express processing as one day. This timing is service-specific and not a guarantee of issuance.
This does not establish visa-free, eVisa, visa-on-arrival, diplomatic/service-passport, Afghan-origin, residence, third-country-document, work, transit, or final-admission treatment.
